text:
maria: Dropping a new compact roles mock + updated invite drawer behavior in Figma: https://figma.com/file/COMPACT_ROLES

maria: Main problems we're trying to solve: too many clicks to preview effective permissions, SSO toggle copy is terse, and audit-log filters disappear when navigating out. Feedback welcome.

derek: Compact grid looks great for power users. A few UX nits: role names alone are ambiguous (e.g., 'Admin' vs 'Org Admin'). Can we show a 1-line summary under the name in small type?

derek: Also the role-row hover currently reveals 4 interactive chips. That's a lot for keyboard users. Suggest a single "Preview permissions" button that opens a small popover with SR-friendly content.

zoe: +1 on single preview action. For screen readers announce: "Preview permissions for Role X. Press enter to open." Use aria-expanded on the button and aria-live on the popover.

ash: Minor copy ask for SSO toggle: current label "Enforce SSO" reads harsh. Propose: "Require SSO for org sign-in" with helper line: "Does not sign out active sessions; new sign-ins require SSO." Put helper text in aria-describedby so it is read by screen readers.

maria: Good. Also found a keyboard trap: open invite drawer -> tab into role details modal -> Shift+Tab doesn't return focus to drawer header. We should trap focus inside the topmost modal and ensure Esc bubbles to close nested panels.

zoe: For mobile/touch, hover previews won't work. Use an inline chevron that expands a collapsed permission summary. Keep the data identical to desktop hover.

ash: Audit log navigation: QA flagged that date range + actor filters reset when clicking into Roles then back. We should persist state in URL params (so back button restores it). Also add a small toast: "Filters preserved" when navigating.

qa-bot: QA steps: reproduce on Mac/Chrome. Steps attached to ticket QA-8102. Reproducible.

eng-bot: FYI: persisting audit filters via URL params is reasonable. Need to avoid storing huge query payloads; keep actor id/time range/levels only. Will estimate after we get design for preserved state UI.

maria: Action items:
- change SSO label + helper text and aria-describedby (ash)
- swap many chips for one keyboard-accessible "Preview permissions" action per row (derek + zoe)
- trap keyboard focus in invite drawer and ensure nested modals close with Esc (eng ticket)
- persist audit log filters in URL and show subtle UI affordance that filters are preserved (eng + qa)
- mobile fallback: inline expanders for permission summaries (zoe)

design-bot: Created ticket PROD-5294: "Compact roles: preview action + SSO helper copy + focus trap" and assigned to eng-ux.

maria: Can design post a high-fidelity compact screen showing the single preview button + aria notes by EOD? Eng needs it to scope the focus-trap work.

derek: I'll mock the preview popover content (short verbs + accessible markup) and add code examples for the button aria attributes.

zoe: I'll write the SR announcement wording and mobile expander behavior.

ash: I'll draft the SSO helper copy and include the exact aria-describedby string.

maria: Great sync. We'll track follow-ups in PROD-5294 and QA-8102. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
